title: Manage Ollama models from susi: list, pull, show, remove
goal: Add `susi ecosystem models <engine>` for Ollama through its HTTP API (/api/tags, /api/pull with progress, /api/show, /api/delete) behind the local_ecosystem Probe so it is testable offline. Refuse pulls that exceed the disk budget. Tests named ollama_models_* with a fake HTTP server.
